causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand in New South Wales reached a maximum for the day of 13 276 MW, 1400 MW greater than that forecast four and 12 hours ahead

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: At around 9 am, AEMO increased the forecast demand for New South Wales by 800 MW which saw four hour ahead forecast prices increasing to the price cap for the 1 pm to 5 pm trading intervals inclusive

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Planned network outages in New South Wales significantly reduced the capability for imports from Victoria

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: The impact of these outages was not forecast, with import capability up to 900 MW lower than forecast four hours ahead

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: An outage of the Mt Piper to Wallerawang 330kV line in New South Wales commenced at 6.05 am

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: the Avon to Macarthur 330kV line, which had been out of service for planned maintenance since 15 November

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding in both New South Wales and Queensland also contributed to prices exceeding $5000/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 9.05 am, effective from 9.15 am, Millmerran Energy Trader rebid 135 MW of capacity at Millmerran unit two from prices below $10/MWh to above $9500/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 9.45 am, effective from 9.55 am, Callide Power Trading rebid 69 MW of capacity at Callide C unit three from prices below $20/MWh to above $9200/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 10.36 am, for the 11 am and 11.30 am trading intervals, Delta Electricity reduced the available capacity at Wallerawang unit seven by 100 MW

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At midday, effective from 12.10 pm, Macquarie Generation reduced the available capacity of Liddell unit two by up to 200 MW

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 2.07 pm, effective from 2.15 pm, Delta Electricity rebid 120 MW of available capacity at Colongra from prices below zero to above $9800/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 3.12 pm, effective from 3.20 pm, Delta rebid 200 MW of available capacity at Mount Piper from prices below zero to above $9500/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 3.11 pm, also effective from 3.20 pm, Delta reduced the available capacity of Colongra unit four by 175 MW

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 2.32 pm, effective from 2.40 pm, CS Energy rebid 55 MW of available capacity at Callide B two from prices below $25/MWh to above $9200/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: A further rebid at 2.47 pm, effective from 2.55 pm, shifted 101 MW of available capacity at Swanbank unit E from prices below zero to above $9800/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 2.34 pm, effective from 3.05 pm Millmerran Energy Trader rebid 135 MW of available capacity at Millmerran unit two from prices below $10/MWh to above $9500/MWh

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: A further rebid at 3.01 pm, effective from 3.10 pm, reduced the capacity of Millmerran unit one by 185 MW

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Around 3000 MW of New South Wales generation was not offered into the market on the day

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Delta Electricity Munmorah unit four 300 Planned - off since March

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Vales Point unit six 660 Planned - off since 6 November

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Macquarie Generation Liddell unit three 520 Planned - off since 24 October

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Eraring Energy Eraring unit four 660 Planned - off since 21 August

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Redbank Redbank 145 Planned - off since 13 November

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Eraring Energy Eraring unit two 660 Plant problems - shutdown on 19 November

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Planned network outages in New South Wales significantly reduced the capability for imports from Victoria

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: For the 11.30 am trading interval, actual capability into New South Wales from Victoria was 900 MW lower than that forecast four hours ahead

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Flows across all interconnectors into New South Wales exceeded the limit for the majority of the time between 9.45 am and 11.20 am

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The two New South Wales to Queensland interconnectors were unconstrained from midday to the end of the high priced period

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: At 10 am, in response to low reserves in New South Wales, AEMO issued a direction to Delta Electricity to bid Colongra unit one available

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: Intervention pricing was applied for the period from 10.10 am to 11.35 am

constraints_named.quote: At 9.45 am, effective from 9.55 am, Callide Power Trading rebid 69 MW of capacity at Callide C unit three from prices below $20/MWh to above $9200/MWh. The reason given was "QNI constraint"

interconnectors_named.name: New South Wales to Queensland interconnectors
interconnectors_named.quote: The two New South Wales to Queensland interconnectors were unconstrained from midday to the end of the high priced period

interconnectors_named.name: Victoria to New South Wales interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Planned network outages in New South Wales significantly reduced the capability for imports from Victoria

intervals.quote: On 20 November 2009, the spot price in New South Wales and Queensland exceeded $5000/MWh for 10 trading intervals in total

network_outages.quote: Planned network outages in New South Wales significantly reduced the capability for imports from Victoria. The impact of these outages was not forecast, with import capability up to 900 MW lower than forecast four hours ahead
